pairwise_results_to_matrix()

Source: vignettes/function_reference/pairwise_results_to_matrix.Rmd
pairwise_results_to_matrix.Rmd
pairwise_results_to_matrix(adata, plot=True, alpha=0.05)

Build a region similarity matrix and network plot from MMD results.

Description

Builds a region-by-region adjacency matrix from adata.uns["repspat_mmd_results"], connecting regions whose adjusted p-value is at least alpha (i.e. regions that could not be statistically distinguished). Optionally draws the corresponding network graph.

Arguments

Argument Description
adata AnnData object containing MMD comparison results (see multiple_comparison()), or a DataFrame with the same columns.
plot Whether to draw the network graph in addition to returning the matrix. Default True.
alpha Significance threshold used to decide which regions are linked. Default 0.05.

Value

A region-by-region adjacency DataFrame. Regions considered similar (repeated patterns) are connected with their observed MMD as the edge weight; regions found to be significantly different are left unconnected (0).

Example 

matrix = pairwise_results_to_matrix(adata)
